Kōzō Mito (Japanese: 三戸耕三 Mito Kōzō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Mito was born on June 8, 1979, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , voicing Samuel, the assistant to . Then, during , he voiced his best-known role in the animated series, Conway, one of 's secondary rivals in the Sinnoh region. Mito is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
